rules.deck: Your decks: 20 cards from your challenge collection, 2 with the same name at most, at least one Basic Pokémon (each copy must be owned). Two decks per format: one you attack with, one the server plays when you are attacked (your attack deck defends until you build it).
rules.setup: You start with 5 cards in hand, always with a Basic Pokémon: put one as your Active Pokémon and up to 3 on your Bench. A coin decides who goes first.
rules.turn: Each turn: draw a card, attach your energy zone's energy to any of your Pokémon (none on the first turn of the battle; one not attached is lost), put Basic Pokémon on your Bench, evolve, retreat once, then attack, which ends your turn. The player going first can't attack on that turn.
rules.evolve: Evolve by putting a card on the Pokémon it evolves from, not on its first turn in play nor on your first turn. The energy and damage stay.
rules.retreat: Retreat: your Active Pokémon goes to the Bench and one of your Benched Pokémon comes in, for its retreat cost in energy. Special conditions go away.
rules.attack: An attack costs its printed energy: each type symbol needs an energy of that type, Colorless any type. Your deck has 1 or 2 energy types, and the zone brings one of them each turn. Its effects are played: coins, damage per energy or counter, special conditions, healing, damage to the Bench... A text the battles can't play is marked, its damage still counts. Weakness doubles the damage, resistance takes {resistance} off.
rules.conditions: Asleep and Paralyzed Pokémon can't attack or retreat (a coin wakes them, Paralysis ends after a turn); Confused ones flip before attacking; Poison deals 10 and Burn 20 between turns.
rules.points: Knocking out a Pokémon gives points: 1 for most, 2 for ex, EX, GX, V and VSTAR, 3 for VMAX, TAG TEAM and Mega ex. {points} points win, so does leaving the other side with no Pokémon. After {turns} turns, the most points win.
rules.hidden: Against players, the server plays their defense deck while you play: their hand stays hidden, their Pokémon show up as they're played.
rules.elo: Against players, no coins: you win or lose Elo points, more against a stronger player. Your opponent is drawn among the players closest to your Elo.
rules.limit: {count} attacks a day, reset at {time}. Defenses are unlimited.
rules.bots: Bots: the same battle with your attack deck, against a deck the server builds from the format. No Elo, and they don't use your attacks. A win pays {easy}, {normal} or {hard} coins (easy, normal, hard), a draw half, for your first {paid} bot battles of the day; {count} a day in all.
rules.trainers: Trainers, like in Pocket: Items as many as you like, 1 Supporter a turn (not on the first turn of the battle), Pokémon Tools attached to a Pokémon until it's knocked out, 1 ACE SPEC per deck. Only the Trainers whose whole text the battles can play: Stadiums and the ones about Energy or Prize cards aren't played yet. You pick what you discard, what you take from your deck and which Pokémon; looking at the top of your deck, the server takes the best card for you.
rules.abilities: Abilities, like in Pocket: the ones used from the board once a turn (some only from the Active Spot or the Bench), the ones always on (less damage, no retreat cost, damage back...), and the ones played as you put the Pokémon on your Bench or evolve into it. Only the abilities whose whole text the battles can play; the others are marked.
